items.headline: Kevin Jennings breaks SMU's TD passing record in win over Cal
items.description: Kevin Jennings threw three touchdowns to break Tanner Mordecai's career record at SMU in the Mustangs' 59-20 win over Cal on Saturday.

items.headline: Kevin Jennings breaks SMU's TD passing record as No. 23 Mustangs beat Cal 59-20
items.description: — Kevin Jennings threw three touchdowns to break SMU's career record, Kendrick Raphael ran for 104 yards against his former team while accounting for three scores and the No. 23 Mustangs beat California 59-20 after trailing at halftime on Saturday.
